newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Port conditions update - South Korea - Lloyds Shipping.
newsitem.headline: Port conditions update - South Korea - Lloyds Shipping.

text.p: Port conditions from Lloyds Shipping Intelligence Service --
BUSAN, Nov 18 - 178 vessels in port, 62 at berth and 116 at anchorage. Usually two to three days delay due to berth congestion.
ULSAN, Nov 18 - 110 vessels in port, 70 at berth and 40 at anchorage. Usually one to two days delay due to berth congestion.
POHANG, Nov 18 - 32 vessels in port, 30 at berth and two at anchorage. No delay.
INCHON, Nov 18 - 69 vessels in port, 51 at berth and 18 at anchorage. Usually one to two days delay due berth congestion.
